newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Minsa officials on stock offer roadshow.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Minsa officials on stock offer roadshow.

text.p: Officials from Grupo Minsa, Mexico's second largest corn flour producer, are currently on the road promoting an international share issue of up to $75 million, an official said Thursday.

"There was one (meeting with investors) in Guadalajara and in Monterrey today and there will be another in Mexico City tomorrow (Friday)...for the offer that will be made in the third week in March," the official said.

"It will be a mixed offering...the amount more or less expected is between $65 and $75 million," he said."It is not over 21 percent of the company's share capital and will have no green shoe," he said. A green shoe is an overallotment.

Minsa officials will next take their roadshow to the United States and Europe, he said. Revenues received in the offer will go to paying down debts, increasing inventories and boosting working and investment capital.
